overview: The Coterie Encampment is the strategic heart of Bloodfalls, where vampyre commanders oversee crimson-water rituals and military operations.
history: The Coterie seized the canyon shortly after the crimson waters formed.
Command tents and ritual altars were erected to harness the corrupted falls.
Sanguine patrols began sweeping the region from this encampment.
The encampment became the staging ground for Bloodfalls expansion.
hooks: A Coterie commander prepares a major ritual.
Sanguine patrols increase activity around the encampment.
A ritual altar begins pulsing uncontrollably.
A vampyre courier carries a critical artifact.
